store: Ember Cabinet round 2: a dark oiled lantern cabinet on four hewn posts. Base: three roomy hewn bays for the elemental stones (Thunderstone, FrozenFuel, Crystal; 8 units each), reaching forward under a low front board. Above: 12 dark niches in 3 columns x 4 rows behind a face frame, an iron kerb and an open iron grille (no glass), for Frost core, Shield core, Glow worm, Molten core, Black core, Memorial coal, the two orbs, Surtling core, Wisp, Fader's ember and one spare; one kind per bay or niche

frame.atlas_sources: rows 0-31 hewn timber, 32-63 x0-63 end grain, 64-79 and 112-127 dark iron: assets/bunker_r4; 32-63 x64-95 dark oiled timber texel, x96-127 wear swatch, 80-111 dark oiled hewn strip: assets/metalpallet_r3; nothing new

space: Unity prefab space, origin = footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (each copy's collision shape is its own convex hull, shrunk by the Bullet margin so it rests within about a millimetre of what carries it; friction 0.75, restitution 0), dropped in batches onto the frozen earlier copies; each niche's copy sequence is cut into its units in drop order. Each copy: the item's bounds centre at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position), rotated by copy.quat_xyzw (or copy.euler, Unity ZXY), longest side fit_longest_m. unit.position = centre of unit.box = the bounding box of the unit's copies, its bottom lowered to the lowest rotated-bounds corner (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves every settled copy alone).
fill_order: units are listed in fill order (interleaved over the niches); within a niche its units fill bottom up. Show the first n copies of a unit for a partial stack. Later copies rest on earlier ones, earlier ones never move. One item kind per niche (unit.bin = row * 3 + column; row 0 = the stone base bays, rows 1-4 = the niche rows bottom up; column 0 the left as seen from the front; unit.item = the kind the bay or niche is for). Bin 14 (row 4 column 2, top right) is spare: its units have no item, only example_item; it is free for any kind that has no place or more stock than its own. Thunderstone (bin 0), FrozenFuel (bin 1) and Crystal (bin 2) have no rip yet: their bays were laid out with ripped stand-in lumps (Stone, BlackMarble, Flint) at a generic 0.14 m; copies.item names the stand-in, unit.item the kind.

BlackMarble@0.14.note: STAND-IN: the FrozenFuel niche was laid out with this ripped lump (BlackMarble) because FrozenFuel has no rip yet; fit_longest_m 0.14 is a generic size (the cabinet's big-core size), not measured from FrozenFuel. The mod draws the stored item itself at these poses, longest side fit_longest_m.
